key: VICTORIA: \PN, is that you?
en: VICTORIA: \PN, is that you?
ja: ヴィクトリア: \PN　あなたなの?

key: Are you challenging Amaria already?
en: Are you challenging Amaria already?
ja: もう　アマリアに　挑戦するの?

key: Well, I guess if you can, there's no reason not to.
en: Well, I guess if you can, there's no reason not to.
ja: まあ　できるなら　しない理由も　ないわよね。

key: Just be careful with her; I heard she was injured!
en: Just be careful with her; I heard she was injured!
ja: でも　気をつけて　彼女　ケガしてるって　聞いたから!

key: Then again, that didn't seem to affect her battling ability at all from the thrashing she gave our employee...
en: Then again, that didn't seem to affect her battling ability at all from the thrashing she gave our employee...
ja: もっとも　うちの職員を　ボコボコにしたところを　見る限り　バトルの実力には　全然　影響　なさそうだったけど……

key: Anyway, you probably want some advice about her, right?
en: Anyway, you probably want some advice about her, right?
ja: ともかく　彼女についての　アドバイス　欲しいんでしょう?

key: Um... Try... Electric attacks?
en: Um... Try... Electric attacks?
ja: ええと……　電気わざを……　試してみる?

key: No, hold on, don't hang up yet!
en: No, hold on, don't hang up yet!
ja: あ　待って　まだ　切らないで!

key: I'm looking for the notes on her team...
en: I'm looking for the notes on her team...
ja: 彼女のチームの　メモを　探してるから……

key: Here they are!
en: Here they are!
ja: あった!

key: Oh, hey I was right.
en: Oh, hey I was right.
ja: あ　やっぱり　合ってた。

key: She'll fight on the Water Surface where Electric attacks are more powerful, and that goes double for if you're fighting underwater.
en: She'll fight on the Water Surface where Electric attacks are more powerful, and that goes double for if you're fighting underwater.
ja: 彼女は　電気わざが　強くなる　水上フィールドで　戦うわ　水中で　戦う場合は　なおさら　強くなるし。

key: But being the Water Leader, she's definitely going to be ready for that kind of thing, so be careful!
en: But being the Water Leader, she's definitely going to be ready for that kind of thing, so be careful!
ja: でも　水のジムリーダーだけあって　そのあたりは　絶対　対策済みだから　気をつけて!

key: If she drags you below the surface, your options will be pretty limited...
en: If she drags you below the surface, your options will be pretty limited...
ja: 水面下に　引きずり込まれたら　できることは　かなり　限られちゃうわね……

key: But there's one drawback there-- it's hard to use physical moves underwater, which means most of her team uses Special attacks.
en: But there's one drawback there-- it's hard to use physical moves underwater, which means most of her team uses Special attacks.
ja: でも　一つ　弱点が　あって―― 水中じゃ　物理わざが　使いにくいから　彼女のチームは　ほとんど　特殊わざに　頼ってるの。

key: If you have a strong special wall, it may prove invaluable against her!
en: If you have a strong special wall, it may prove invaluable against her!
ja: 特殊耐久の高いポケモンが　いれば　彼女相手には　すごく　役に立つかも!

key: Additionally, you can think about how you'll play around her water field.
en: Additionally, you can think about how you'll play around her water field.
ja: それと　彼女の水フィールドを　どう攻略するかも　考えておくと　いいわ。

key: If you have moves like Dive or Fly, they can get you back up above water!
en: If you have moves like Dive or Fly, they can get you back up above water!
ja: ダイビングとか　そらをとぶ　みたいなわざが　あれば　水面上に　戻れるから!

key: Alternatively you could try freezing or poisoning the water, but those can be double-edged too...
en: Alternatively you could try freezing or poisoning the water, but those can be double-edged too...
ja: あるいは　水を　凍らせたり　毒にしたり　するのも　手だけど　それも　諸刃の剣に　なりうるわね……

key: Maybe it all comes down to timing.
en: Maybe it all comes down to timing.
ja: 結局は　タイミング次第　かもしれないわ。

key: Best of luck!
en: Best of luck!
ja: がんばってね!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールは　誰も　出ないようだな……

key: JULIA: You! With the face!
en: JULIA: You! With the face!
ja: ジュリア: あんた! その顔した人!

key: JULIA: Rini-dingi-dinger just rang from up in Calcenon City!
en: JULIA: Rini-dingi-dinger just rang from up in Calcenon City!
ja: ジュリア: カルセノンシティから　リニリニ電話が　かかってきたよ!

key: Apparently things there aren't lookin' too hot.
en: Apparently things there aren't lookin' too hot.
ja: どうも　あっちの状況は　あんまり　良くないみたい。

key: Despite the Fire Gym and all...
en: Despite the Fire Gym and all...
ja: ほのおジムなのに……

key: I mean, she said nothing was blowing up-- believe me, if it were, I'd already be there!
en: I mean, she said nothing was blowing up-- believe me, if it were, I'd already be there!
ja: というか　何も　爆発してないって　言ってたけど―― 信じて　もし爆発してたら　アタシ　もう　そこに　いってるって!

key: Can't miss those fireworks!
en: Can't miss those fireworks!
ja: あの花火　見逃すわけには　いかないもん!

key: Buuut it sounds like she'd appreciate some help up there!
en: Buuut it sounds like she'd appreciate some help up there!
ja: でもぉ　あっちで　助けを　ありがたく　思ってくれそうって　感じ!

key: I tried to tell Tania, but I don't even know where she went.
en: I tried to tell Tania, but I don't even know where she went.
ja: ターニャに　伝えようとしたんだけど　どこ行ったか　わかんなくて。

key: So, I figured I'd let you know instead!
en: So, I figured I'd let you know instead!
ja: だから　代わりに　あんたに　伝えとくことに　したの!

key: I told that to Tania and she was all like...
en: I told that to Tania and she was all like...
ja: それを　ターニャに　言ったら　こんな感じ　だったの……

key: JULITANIA: Fwah! My cursed sword arm will not allow me to leave this dark realm!
en: JULITANIA: Fwah! My cursed sword arm will not allow me to leave this dark realm!
ja: ジュリターニャ: フワァ! 呪われしこの剣の腕が　この暗黒の領域から　立ち去ることを　許さぬ!

key: JULIA: ...So I figured I'd let you know instead!
en: JULIA: ...So I figured I'd let you know instead!
ja: ジュリア: ……だから　代わりに　あんたに　伝えとくことに　したの!

key: JULIA: If it were me, I'd just blow up all of Labradorra City.
en: JULIA: If it were me, I'd just blow up all of Labradorra City.
ja: ジュリア: アタシなら　ラブラドラシティ　まるごと　吹っ飛ばしちゃうけどね。

key: But for SOME reason, nobody's on board with that plan.
en: But for SOME reason, nobody's on board with that plan.
ja: でも　なぜか　誰も　その案に　乗ってくれないんだよねぇ。

key: Soooo whatever, they lose, I snooze!
en: Soooo whatever, they lose, I snooze!
ja: まあ　どうでもいっか　あっちの負けで　アタシは　お昼寝!

key: Amaria's gym puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Amaria's gym puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブデータで　アマリアの　ジムパズルが　クリアされた記録が　見つかった。

key: Skip gym puzzle on this file?
en: Skip gym puzzle on this file?
ja: このセーブデータでも　ジムパズルを　スキップしますか?

key: You have not completed the gym on this story route.
en: You have not completed the gym on this story route.
ja: このストーリールートでは　まだ　このジムを　クリアしていません。

key: You may miss out on certain plot elements if you skip to the gym battle.
en: You may miss out on certain plot elements if you skip to the gym battle.
ja: ジムバトルに　スキップすると　一部の物語の要素を　見逃す可能性が　あります。

key: Continue?
en: Continue?
ja: 続けますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
